g.text: R4 / LR 1e-4 / development fold 0 | endpoint | step 10246

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Inner only: 13,482 pairs; 1,089 evaluable diseases; 820 lacking P or U omitted from curves.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: U means unlabeled. These are P-vs-U proxy diagnostics; outer/final remain unscored.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Curves: mean at common x values; shade: disease 10th–90th percentile, not a confidence interval.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: AUC/AP annotations are means of original per-disease metrics. Gridded curve areas are not those metrics.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: AP uses the unchanged threshold-group definition; dashed PR line is mean disease P prevalence.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Matrix: all inner rows, row percentages; fixed logit ≥ 0, uncalibrated and not tuned to these labels.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Counts do not establish clinical TN/FP or calibrated probabilities. One checkpoint; no new model forward.
